name: Sobble
description: Sobble, the Water Lizard Pokémon. Able to evolve into Drizzile. A Water type.
pokedex_entries: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.
When it gets wet, its skin changes color, and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if it were camouflaged.
